themes.evidence: Our therapies help 72 million people a year and support our Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life.
Read about the efforts to create an inclusive and diverse workplace at Medtronic, one that mirrors the world in which we live and work, and to further our corporate Mission.

Download Medtronic Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Reports and learn how Medtronic adds value to society, promotes environmental stewardship, supports a global workforce, and works responsibly.

Our people make it possible. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our 90,000+ employees to be themselves. We hold each other accountable, act with integrity, and make quality our highest priority.
